store.name: DevFest Store
delivery: Pick up free at the DevFest Store booth, same day.
Ilorin: same day for orders placed before 2pm, ₦1,500.
Other cities in Nigeria: 2–4 working days, ₦3,500.
returns: Return unused items within 7 days for a full refund.
Opened earbuds can be returned only if they are faulty.
Every gadget has a 6-month warranty against faults.
Refunds go back to the original payment method within 3 working days.
payment: Card, bank transfer, or pay at the booth.

products.name: 20,000mAh power bank
products.summary: Charges a phone four times over. Lasts the whole conference.
products.description: A slim 20,000mAh power bank with 22.5W fast charging. Charges two devices at once, and the screen shows exactly how much charge is left.

products.name: Wireless earbuds
products.summary: Noise-cancelling earbuds for calls, talks and the trip home.
products.description: Wireless earbuds with active noise cancelling and a clear microphone for calls. 6 hours per charge, 24 hours with the case.

products.name: Selfie stick tripod
products.summary: A selfie stick that turns into a tripod, with a Bluetooth remote.
products.description: Extends to 1m for group photos and folds out into a steady tripod for videos. The Bluetooth remote clips off so you can shoot from a distance.

products.name: Clip-on ring light
products.summary: Clips onto your phone or laptop for brighter photos and calls.
products.description: A rechargeable ring light that clips onto a phone or laptop. Three colour temperatures and ten brightness levels for selfies, streams and video calls.

products.name: 6-in-1 USB-C hub
products.summary: HDMI, USB and a card reader for laptops with only USB-C.
products.description: Connect a projector, USB drives and SD cards to a USB-C laptop. Supports 4K HDMI and passes 100W charging through.

products.name: Mini Bluetooth speaker
products.summary: Small enough for a bag, loud enough for a room.
products.description: A palm-sized Bluetooth speaker with 12 hours of play and a built-in microphone for calls. Splash resistant.

products.name: DevFest Ilorin 2026 T-shirt
products.summary: The official DevFest Ilorin 2026 T-shirt in soft cotton.
products.description: Soft cotton T-shirt with the DevFest Ilorin 2026 print on the front. Unisex fit.

products.name: Developer sticker pack
products.description: 30 waterproof vinyl stickers: Firebase, Android, Flutter, Google Developer Groups and a few DevFest Ilorin specials.

products.name: Insulated water bottle
products.summary: Keeps water cold for 24 hours through every session.
products.description: A 750ml steel bottle that keeps drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12. Leak-proof lid with a carry loop.
